messages:
margot: Quick heads-up — Hosted API streaming + tool-calling v3 is GA 🎉 Rolling out now to all regions. Major highlights: schema-enforced streaming frames, backpressure-friendly chunking, improved tool-call argument validation, and deterministic detokenization for tool outputs. Docs + migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/v3/tool-calling

devin: Awesome — what's the rollout cadence and any forced client changes?

margot: Staged rollout over the next 48h (region-by-region). No auth changes. We will redirect /v2/toolcall -> /v3 for 30 days but recommend upgrading within 2 weeks. See migration notes in the docs for quick diffs.

sam: Migration checklist added to docs (short version): update api_version to v3, verify streaming frame handling, update SDKs to latest. Example snippet: `from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"), api_version="v3")
resp = client.tool_call.stream(...)`

alexa: Marketing will prepare a blog + short announcement. Can someone DM a 1-2 sentence exec quote? :megaphone:

margot: Ping me — happy to provide a quote. Also note: we bumped default rate limits for tool-calling customers on paid plans to reduce throttles during migration.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy started for hosted-toolcall-service us-east-1 — build=2026.3.10-723, canary=true, status=in-progress

devin: Any breaking changes to streaming frames consumers should watch for?

sam: Slight schema change: streaming frame objects now use `chunk` (string), `complete` (bool), and `tool_call` (object|null). SDKs will map to old shape when api_version!=v3, but raw webhook consumers must adapt. Small code example in docs.

devin: Also flagged a race around KV cache for very long chats — QA found it and a patch went to canary this morning. Will monitor.

sam: Observability: new dashboards live -> https://console.redwood.ai/ops/dashboards/toolcall-v3 and alerts prewired for regression in latency/tokenization mismatches.

margot: Customer comms: we'll email tenants with >10k req/day by EOD summarizing impact + migration steps. If you own high-touch accounts, please add any special notes. For urgent incidents, @eng-oncall is the channel. Thanks all! :rocket:
